map.养殖户对比叶轮式、水车式、微孔曝气等不同机型单位功率可覆盖的水面面积。: Farmers compare the water surface area each type of unit power can cover for paddlewheel, water wheel and micro-bubble aeration.
map.叶轮式、水车式、微孔曝气怎么选？: How do I choose between paddlewheel, water wheel and micro-bubble aeration?
map.叶轮式提水与上下水层交换强，适合深水位主养鱼塘；水车式推动水体循环、增氧均匀，适: A paddlewheel lifts water and exchanges upper and lower layers strongly, so it suits deep-water grow-out ponds; a water wheel drives circulation and oxygenates evenly, so it suits shallow shrimp and crab ponds; micro-bubble aeration produces fine bubbles with high oxygen utilisation but needs a blower, so it suits high-level ponds and workshop recirculating water.
map.常规精养鱼塘经验值为 0.3~0.5 kW/亩；南美白对虾、黄颡鱼等高耗氧品种或: A rule of thumb for ordinary intensive fish ponds is 0.3-0.5 kW per mu; for high-oxygen-demand species such as Pacific white shrimp and yellow catfish, or for high-density farming, this can rise to 0.6-0.75 kW per mu. The final figure should also take account of water depth, water exchange conditions and how long aeration runs at night.
map.新建或改造养殖池塘时，按水面面积、水深与养殖品种初配增氧机总功率与台数。: When building or renovating a farming pond, make a first estimate of the total aerator power and unit count from the water surface area, depth and species.
map.每亩配多少千瓦增氧机比较合适？: How many kilowatts of aerator per mu are appropriate?
map.输入池塘面积、水深、养殖品种与目标溶氧提升量，估算所需增氧机总功率与台数，辅助水: Enter the pond area, depth, species and the target dissolved oxygen increase to estimate the total aerator power and unit count needed, supporting aeration equipment selection in aquaculture.
map.高密度养殖（如对虾、黄颡鱼）夏季夜间溶氧风险高，需校核增氧能力是否够。: High-density farming (such as prawns and yellow catfish) carries a high night-time dissolved oxygen risk in summer, so check whether the aeration capacity is sufficient.
map.：精养鲤鲫塘按单位面积 0.5 kW/亩估算，10 亩需总功率约 5 kW。选: : an intensive carp and crucian pond at 0.5 kW per mu needs about 5 kW for 10 mu. With a 1.5 kW paddlewheel aerator the count is 5 / 1.5, about 3.3, so round up to 4 units (allowing for a spare and zoned placement). High-density ponds or shrimp ponds can go up to 0.6-0.75 kW per mu.
